name: Fantasy
tone: Heroic high fantasy: brave deeds, ancient magic, wonder with real danger.

roles.name: Fighter
roles.summary: A trained warrior who holds the line with steel and grit.

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.description: Bonus action: regain 1d10 + your level in HP.

abilities.name: Fighting Style: Defence
abilities.description: While wearing armour you gain +1 AC (the GM applies this).

roles.name: Rogue
roles.summary: A quick, quiet specialist in locks, traps and knives in the dark.

abilities.name: Sneak Attack
abilities.description: Once per turn, deal an extra 1d6 damage with a finesse or ranged weapon if you have advantage or an ally is next to the target.

abilities.name: Thieves' Cant
abilities.description: You know the secret signs and slang of thieves.

roles.name: Wizard
roles.summary: A scholar of the arcane who bends reality with study and will.

abilities.name: Spellcasting (Intelligence)
abilities.description: Cantrips: Fire Bolt (1d10 fire, ranged spell attack), Mage Hand, Light. 1st-level spells prepared: Magic Missile (three darts, 1d4+1 force each, never miss), Shield (reaction, +5 AC until your next turn), Sleep, Detect Magic. Spell attack = Int mod + proficiency; save DC = 8 + Int mod + proficiency.

abilities.name: Arcane Recovery
abilities.description: Once per day during a short rest, recover one spent 1st-level spell slot.

roles.name: Cleric
roles.summary: A servant of a higher power who heals, wards and smites.

abilities.name: Spellcasting (Wisdom)
abilities.description: Cantrips: Sacred Flame (1d8 radiant, Dex save), Guidance, Light. 1st-level spells prepared: Cure Wounds (1d8 + Wis mod healing), Healing Word (bonus action, 1d4 + Wis mod at range), Bless, Guiding Bolt (4d6 radiant). Save DC = 8 + Wis mod + proficiency.

abilities.name: Disciple of Life
abilities.description: Healing spells restore an extra 2 + the spell's level in HP.

roles.name: Ranger
roles.summary: A wilderness tracker and archer at home far from roads.

abilities.name: Favoured Enemy
abilities.description: Choose a creature type with the GM: advantage on Survival to track them and on Intelligence checks to recall facts about them.

abilities.name: Natural Explorer
abilities.description: In your favoured terrain, difficult terrain doesn't slow your group and you can't get lost except by magic.

roles.name: Bard
roles.summary: A performer whose stories and songs carry real power.

abilities.name: Bardic Inspiration
abilities.description: Bonus action: give an ally a d6 they can add to one roll in the next 10 minutes.

abilities.name: Spellcasting (Charisma)
abilities.description: Cantrips: Vicious Mockery (1d4 psychic, Wis save, disadvantage on next attack), Minor Illusion. 1st-level spells known: Healing Word, Charm Person, Dissonant Whispers, Faerie Fire. Save DC = 8 + Cha mod + proficiency.

openingHooks: A dying courier stumbles into the tavern and presses a sealed map into your hands before the hooded riders arrive.
The village well has started whispering at night, and the children who listen stop speaking by morning.
The duke offers a fortune to anyone who will escort his estranged daughter through the haunted Greywood before the solstice.

starts.title: The Gilded Goose Tavern
starts.description: A crowded roadside inn at the edge of the Greywood, loud with drovers, minstrels and rumours, on the night the hooded riders come.
hooks: A dying courier presses a sealed map into your hands
The bard's song names someone in this room as a murderer

starts.title: The Drowned Bell
starts.description: A flooded chapel in the fen-village of Marrowmere, where a bronze bell still tolls beneath the black water every midnight.
hooks: Dive for the bell before it rings again
Ask the ferryman why he will not cross after dark

starts.title: Caravan to Saltreach
starts.description: Day nine on a merchant caravan crossing the Glass Flats, water running low and the guide missing since dawn.
hooks: Track the guide's footprints into the dunes
Search the wagons: someone is hoarding water

starts.title: The Prisoner Hulk
starts.description: Shackled in the hold of a prison barge drifting down the Iron River toward the mines, with a storm coming and the guards drunk.
hooks: Pick the lock while thunder covers the noise
Make a pact with the hooded prisoner chained beside you

starts.title: Festival of Lanterns
starts.description: The free city of Vellmarch on its brightest night, ten thousand paper lanterns rising over the canals as a noble is poisoned at the masked ball.
hooks: Catch the masked servant fleeing the ballroom
Taste the wine before the city guard seals the hall

starts.title: Ruins of Kael Tor
starts.description: A crumbling dwarven watchtower on a mountain pass, where the party shelters from a blizzard and finds the stairs leading down are freshly swept.
hooks: Follow the stairs into the dark
Wake the frozen traveller slumped by the door

starts.title: The Wizard's Auction
starts.description: A sealed manor where the belongings of a vanished archmage are being sold to the highest bidder, and one lot is bidding back.
hooks: Bid on the whispering music box
Slip upstairs to the archmage's locked study

starts.title: Siege of Brannock Keep
starts.description: A border castle three days into a siege by an orc warband, food rationed and morale breaking, as the lord asks for volunteers.
hooks: Sneak out through the old smugglers' tunnel
Parley with the warlord under a flag of truce

starts.title: The Moonlit Grove
starts.description: A druid circle deep in the Elderwood where the standing stones have begun bleeding sap, and the animals have gone silent.
hooks: Ask the ancient oak what wounded it
Follow the trail of dead birds northward

starts.title: Shipwreck on the Teeth
starts.description: Washed up on a jagged island after your ship struck the reef called the Teeth, with three other survivors and a locked sea-chest.
hooks: Open the chest the captain died protecting
Climb toward the smoke rising from the island's peak

starts.title: The Thieves' Market
starts.description: The Undercroft, a bazaar of stolen goods beneath the city of Ashport, where a fence offers the party a job too well paid to be honest.
hooks: Take the job: steal a reliquary from the cathedral
Find out who really hired the fence

starts.title: Plague Gate
starts.description: A quarantined river town whose gates were sealed a week ago, the party trapped inside as the sickness spreads and a cure is rumoured in the old temple.
hooks: Break into the temple vault
Help the healer smuggle children over the wall

starts.title: The Dragon's Tithe
starts.description: A mountain village preparing its once-a-decade tribute to the red dragon Vorathyx, short one chest of gold and one volunteer.
hooks: Find the stolen gold before sundown
Climb to the lair to bargain directly

starts.title: The Crossroads Gallows
starts.description: A lonely crossroads at dusk where a condemned stranger begs the party to cut him down, swearing he knows where the king's lost heir is hidden.
hooks: Cut him down and hear his story
Wait for the executioner to arrive

artStyle: Painterly digital illustration in the style of a modern fantasy roleplaying sourcebook. Realistic proportions, detailed costume and gear, dramatic rim lighting, visible brushwork, rich but slightly muted colours.
